descriptions: You can download a trial version of this app to try it for 15 minutes for free.
You won’t be charged anything when this free trial ends. You can’t make in-app purchases or use add-on content during this free trial, but you’ll keep any achievements you earn.

display_long_description:
The crowd is roaring, the sun is out and the bowler is at the top of his mark. Take guard.

A SOLD-OUT STADIUM
A two-tier bowl with 42,000 fans who clap, cheer, leap to their feet for a six and roll a Mexican wave round the ground. LED boards flash FOUR and SIX, giant screens show the chase, and a grand old pavilion watches over it all.

FACE REAL BOWLERS
Fast bowlers, swing bowlers and spinners run in and deliver for real: swing through the air, seam off the pitch, off-breaks and leg-breaks that turn. Every delivery is real ball physics.

HIT IT INTO THE CROWD
A cricket bat in your hand with a satisfying crack off the middle. Time it well and the ball flies into the stands, with your longest six saved on the big screen.

A FULL FIELDING SIDE
Nine fielders chase it down, dive under catches and throw it in. The keeper takes the edges and the umpire signals every four, six and wicket. Get bowled, caught or trapped LBW with ball tracking.

THE CHASE
Ten T20 finishes, from your first match to the World Final. Need 16 off 12? Every level is a target, a few overs and a few wickets in hand.

SIX SMASH AND NETS
Twelve balls to hit as many sixes as you can, or practise in the nets at your own pace.

BRITISH TV COMMENTARY
Two commentators call the play and talk you through every big moment.

No account, no internet, no in-app purchases.
